overview: Cartao is a star system in the Expansion Region, within the Prackla Sector, at galactic grid O-8, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Cartao appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Expansion Region.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Cartao's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Cartao is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Expansion Region chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Expansion Region sector records
